hooks.command: case "$file_path" in */lib/design_system/src/*.dart) b=$(basename "$file_path" .dart); p=$(echo "$b" | perl -pe 's/(^|_)(.)/uc($2)/ge'); m=""; [ ! -f "lib/design_system/.specs/${p}.genesis.md" ] && m="genesis doc (.specs/${p}.genesis.md)"; grep -q "$p" lib/design_system/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md 2>/dev/null || { [ -n "$m" ] && m="$m, "; m="${m}Widget Catalog row in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md"; }; [ -n "$m" ] && echo "Widget '${p}' missing: ${m}"; true;; esac; true
